summary.short: Royal Decree creating a time-limited controlled testing environment (regulatory sandbox) in Spain for providers and users to test compliance with the proposed EU AI Regulation; open only to entities resident or with a permanent establishment in Spain; in force the day after BOE publication.
summary.long: The Decree creates a time-limited controlled testing environment (regulatory sandbox) run by the Secretaría de Estado de Digitalización e Inteligencia Artificial, to test how requirements of the proposed EU AI Regulation can be met. Eligible are AI providers and their users resident in Spain or with a permanent establishment there (Art. 5(1)). Covered systems are high-risk systems, general-purpose AI systems and foundation models; military, subliminal-manipulation, vulnerability-exploiting, social-scoring and real-time law-enforcement biometric systems are excluded (Art. 5(6)). Admission follows a public call, evaluation criteria and a resolution (Arts. 6-10); participants agree an implementation plan (Art. 11(2)). They must meet risk management, data quality, documentation, logging, transparency, human oversight and accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity requirements (Art. 11(1)), file a self-assessment declaration (Art. 13), run post-market monitoring (Art. 14) and report serious incidents (Art. 15). Personal data must follow the GDPR and LOPDGDD (Art. 16); participants are liable for damage caused by non-compliance or fault (Art. 17). The competent body may terminate individual participation (Art. 25), publishes a conclusions report (Disp. Add. 2) and may issue guides (Art. 22). The Decree lasts up to 36 months or until the EU regulation applies (Final provision 2).

notes: target_instrument_id is empty because the document does not give registry IDs for the cited instruments; the target is in target_text. Annex VII lists 12 EU harmonised product acts (e.g., Directive 2006/42/CE on machinery) referred to by art. 3.4.a; they are not coded as separate relations. Internal inconsistencies: (1) Preamble II gives the Council position as 25 November 2022, while Annex I says it was published in December 2022. (2) Disposición final primera says 'Esta Ley se aprueba', though the instrument is a Real Decreto. (3) Several citation numbers are misprinted (Ley 40/215; Reglamento (UE) 241/2021; Reglamento (UE) 679/2016; LOPDPGDD in Annex IV). (4) Silence rules differ: art. 10.3 (admission) is negative, art. 24.2 (voluntary withdrawal) is positive. The registry entry-into-force date of 10/11/2023 matches the text's 'al día siguiente de su publicación' (BOE of 09/11/2023). section_status.relations is set to not_applicable only because the schema requires that field; relations are listed above.
